problem_statement: Incoming IPv6 Neighbor Discovery packets (Router Advertisement, Neighbor Solicitation and Neighbor Advertisement) are not correctly validated on input. A packet whose IPv6 hop limit is not the required ND hop limit (255) but that carries a valid (zero) ICMPv6 code is accepted and processed instead of being dropped. Such malformed ND packets must be dropped regardless of the ICMPv6 code, and the ND drop counter must reflect each dropped packet.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/ipv6 -s tests/net/ipv6/net.ipv6 -s net.ipv6 -O twister-out --no-clean -W
